name: Marketplace Activity
description: Raw marketplace activity: unique daily profile/service views, searches and search-result clicks (activity/events.py). Visitors are stored only as a daily-rotating HMAC (visitor_hash); no IP, cookie or guest identity. Rows older than the retention period (default 90 days) are purged daily; daily totals live in Marketplace Daily Metric.

fields.label: Visitor Hash
fields.description: HMAC of the visitor key with the site secret and the day. Changes every day; cannot be reversed.

fields.label: Dedupe Key
fields.description: Set for views and clicks: one per visitor per day (views) or per search result (clicks). Empty for searches.

fields.label: Query
fields.description: Searches only: normalised, at most 100 characters, digit runs masked.

fields.label: Result Refs
fields.description: Searches only: JSON list of the returned results (entity:name), at most 50, to validate clicks.

fields.label: Search
fields.description: Clicks only: the search the result came from.
